experiments.description: (BOS, X, X): X is 10 random tokens repeated once.
(BOS, X, Y): same BOS and X as the repeated suite, then 10 fresh random tokens. Control: no repetition.

(BOS, X, X): X is 50 random tokens repeated once.

IOI template BABA-t00 (Wang et al. 2022, Appendix E), e.g. "Then, Andrew and Thomas went to the house. Andrew gave a computer to". Names, place and object vary per prompt; positions IO, S1, S1+1, S2, END are the same for all.

Paired control for IOI template BABA-t00: same IO, S1, place and object as the IOI prompt of the same seed, but the S2 slot holds a third name, so no name repeats (pABC-style), e.g. "Then, Andrew and Thomas went to the house. James gave a computer to". Positions name the same template slots.

environment.precision: scores rounded to 6 decimals; attention assets float16
environment.published circuit:gpt2-small:ioi:wang-20: IOI annotations v1.0.0 (arXiv:2211.00593v1; code https://github.com/redwoodresearch/Easy-Transformer@e168301; verified 2026-10-28, see docs/sources/ioi-wang-2022.md)

provenance.notes: Measured here: attention-pattern detectors on repeated random tokens, with a paired non-repeated control, and attention between named positions on IOI prompts built from the paper's templates, with a paired control where S2 is a third name. Every score is 'experimental' (heuristic attention, not causal evidence). Published, not measured here: the IOI circuit of Wang et al. (2022), imported from reviewed annotations. No measured score verifies a published role.
